opening.quote: Good morning, Tidewell Home, my name is Femke. How can I help today?
opening.comment: The greeting gives the agent's name and the company name, so this criterion is met.

verification.quote: Can I take your full name and the border number or postcode?
verification.comment: Verification was requested, and the caller gave a surname and postcode, but the agent then addressed the caller as Mark and later as mike, so the name confirmation was not handled cleanly; the caller's full name was also not confirmed before the payment details were shared.

understanding.quote: Thank you, Mark. I can see a payment of €120.00 for a dining chair set.
understanding.comment: The agent identified the dispute correctly and did not ask again for information already given, though the caller's name was misheard, so the caller's details were not captured accurately.

resolution_accuracy.quote: Your bank we'll contact you where their decision.
resolution_accuracy.comment: The agent gave no wrong timeline, but the statement was garbled and did not explain that the Payments team handles disputes and replies within 2 working days, so the information given was incomplete and unclear.

process_compliance.quote: I'll make uh note on your order that you've opened a dispute.
process_compliance.comment: Bank disputes must be passed to the Payments team, but the agent instead only added a note and did not transfer the case to Payments, so a required step was missed.

communication.quote: Thank you for calling Tidewell, mike. Take care.
communication.comment: The agent was polite overall, but the caller's name was wrong at the close, and the caller did not express frustration that needed acknowledging.

closing.quote: I'll email you today to confirm the note on your order. Is there anything else I can help with?
closing.comment: The agent confirmed a next step, asked if there was anything else, and closed politely, so this criterion is met.
